sources.title: Git — git-merge
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Git bisect：單調故障定位與不可測提交
related.titleEn: Git bisect: monotonic regression search and untestable commits
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付merge-matrix.csv、臨時repo的merge圖與失敗/修正測試。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver merge-matrix.csv, the temporary-repo graph and failing/repaired checks.
related.difference: 製作有明確首個bad的臨時提交序列，測試以退出0為good、1為bad、125為skip。
related.differenceEn: Create a temporary history with a known first bad commit; use exit 0 for good,1 for bad and 125 for skip.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
三方合併比較base、ours、theirs；文字自動合併成功不表示組合後行為正確。
教學基準：10*(2+1) = 30 s；對照：20*(4+1) = 100 s。

二分定位需要已知good/bad邊界與可信測試；skip代表不可測，不能為求結束把它誤判為bad。
教學基準：ceil(log2(64)) = 6 decisions；對照：ceil(log2(16)) = 4 decisions。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Three-way merging compares base, ours andtheirs; textual success does not establish correct combined behavior.
Teaching baseline: 10*(2+1) = 30 s; comparison: 20*(4+1) = 100 s.

Bisection needs known good/bad bounds and reliable tests; skip means untestable, not bad merely to finish quickly.
Teaching baseline: ceil(log2(64)) = 6 decisions; comparison: ceil(log2(16)) = 4 decisions.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: pytest：fixture 生命週期與共享狀態污染
related.titleEn: pytest: fixture lifetime and shared-state contamination
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付merge-matrix.csv、臨時repo的merge圖與失敗/修正測試。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver merge-matrix.csv, the temporary-repo graph and failing/repaired checks.
related.difference: 記錄 setup/test/teardown 序列；function 建立12次、module建立3次，每次建立恰有一次釋放，即使測試拋出例外。 完成預測、觀察與反例的對照。
related.differenceEn: Log setup/test/teardown events: function scope creates12 resources, module scope3, each with exactly one teardown even when a test raises. Compare prediction,observation and counterexamples.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
三方合併比較base、ours、theirs；文字自動合併成功不表示組合後行為正確。
教學基準：10*(2+1) = 30 s；對照：20*(4+1) = 100 s。

基準 3*4*0.2 = 2.4 s；對照 3*0.2 = 0.6 s。逐項註記單位、分母、取整與適用域。
記錄 setup/test/teardown 序列；function 建立12次、module建立3次，每次建立恰有一次釋放，即使測試拋出例外。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Three-way merging compares base, ours andtheirs; textual success does not establish correct combined behavior.
Teaching baseline: 10*(2+1) = 30 s; comparison: 20*(4+1) = 100 s.

Baseline 3*4*0.2 = 2.4 s; comparison 3*0.2 = 0.6 s. Annotate units,denominators,rounding and applicability separately.
Log setup/test/teardown events: function scope creates12 resources, module scope3, each with exactly one teardown even when a test raises.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
